item.title: Senate passes bipartisan energy bill amid environmental concerns
item.description:
The Senate passed a sweeping, bipartisan bill Thursday night that's designed to cut permitting timelines for energy and infrastructure projects. Why it matters: The eyes of the entire energy industry are on this bill. If it becomes law, it could transform how America builds energy infrastructure, with major implications for everything from electricity costs to data centers. Getting rid of bureaucratic hurdles and creating a more predictable process for energy projects is a top priority for the fossil fuels and renewables sectors. But critics argue the plan, which has White House support, would unacceptably weaken environmental protections and the rights of Native American tribes. Driving the news: The vote was 62-33. The 9-year-old hippo died from complications after veterinarians and animal-care staff made multiple attempts to save her, according to the Associated Press. item.description:
